milestone: Package 19: adr-check shipped; kit at 19 packages, 151 tests

package.name: dsh-adr-check
package.decides: ADR structure: status, context, decision, consequences including a cost, alternatives considered
package.distinct_rule: consequences-one-sided — an ADR whose consequences list only benefits did not weigh the trade. A record can satisfy every other rule and still be caught by this one, which makes it the rule worth the package.
package.second_rule: consequences-unlabelled — consequences that mark neither benefit nor cost leave the reader unable to tell which line is the price
